title: Working with Joe Ruffino
summary: Ridgley came to know Ruffino, who paid little and kept two sets of books, and refused New York leasing of Same Old Way.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
